criteria.note: Snapshots the tree before and after detect (API and CLI) for five configs: none, empty ui:, partial, declined and configured. The implementation mutation 'a write in detect' was killed (task.md:732).

criteria.description: configure appends a ui: block readUiConfig reads back; refuses exists
criteria.note: Append and read-back at :1662; refusal at :1700. configure refuses exists when the map is set or declined (:1397), the block is inline (:1406) or a key conflicts (:1414). For a partial ui: block it inserts the missing keys instead of refusing, as #6 requires, so #6 narrows 'refuses when a ui: key is present'. Both behaviours are tested.

criteria.note: Round-trips from no file, from an unrelated config and from a partial block. Asserts that detect and ensure both return declined.
